name: Houkago Cinderella 2
source:
As the first buds of spring bloom, Kuzumi Arata finds himself starting anew in a town far from home. Plagued by regrets from his past student life, he wonders what he's been doing with his youth. A part-time job may have kept him financially afloat, but it couldn't fill the void of feeling left out while watching his peers excel in clubs and find love. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he sets his sights on a fresh start at his new school.

Luck seems to be on his side as he meets a cast of exciting characters, including friendly classmates, a beautiful and reserved one, a girl he met on the train, and a cheeky kouhai who keeps him on his toes. However, Arata still struggles with figuring out how to make the most of his student life. That is, until he listens to Oze Hazuki, the kind daughter of his landlord, and decides to enjoy himself at his new school.

But as he settles into his new routine, Arata can't shake the feeling that something is missing. It isn't until he examines his heart that he realizes his true desire: to have an idyllic student life, complete with a girlfriend by his side as they walk home from school together. With this new goal in mind, Arata must find his way through the twists and turns of love and relationships as he tries to live the perfect student life.

translation:
当春天的第一朵花蕾绽放时，久住新田发现自己在一个远离家乡的小镇上重新开始。他对过去的学生生活感到遗憾，他想知道自己的青年时代都在做什么。一份兼职工作或许可以让他在经济上维持生计，但这并不能填补他在看着同龄人在俱乐部中表现出色并找到真爱时感到被忽视的空虚感。他决心改过自新，并把目光投向了在新学校的新开始。

运气似乎站在他这边，他遇到了一群令人兴奋的角色，包括友善的同学、美丽而矜持的人、他在火车上遇到的女孩，以及让他保持警惕的厚脸皮的女孩。然而，Arata仍然在努力思考如何充分利用他的学生生活。也就是说，直到他听从房东善良的女儿尾濑叶月的话，决定在新学校过得愉快。

但当他适应新的生活习惯时，阿拉塔无法摆脱一种缺失了某些东西的感觉。直到他审视自己的内心，他才意识到自己真正的愿望：过着田园诗般的学生生活，放学回家时有一个女朋友在身边。怀揣着这个新目标，阿拉塔必须在爱情和人际关系的曲折中找到出路，努力过上完美的学生生活。
